text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, Tarumae-chan. Thanks for 
treating me the other day~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"It was veeery delicious, with such a 
pretty pink color."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
!! That's right! Haskap berries look 
great, taste great, and are super 
nutritious—they're the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Back home, I often helped the local 
farmers pick haskap berries. The fruit is 
so soft that you have to pick them by 
hand, one by one.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
They're pretty sour when eaten raw, but 
that just makes them all the more 
versatile for sweets and cooking alike!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Hah, a versatile all-rounder usable 
anywhere... Could that be the local idol I 
strive to be...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-I think I might understand now! What I 
should aim to be is definitely an 
all-around local idol, just like a haskap 
berry—!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, my. Hehe, little Tarumae really is 
such a hard worker, isn't she?
